query: How many organisations are currently listed as signatories on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-code-practice) as of July 2026? List the count and names if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

## Answer

**23 organisations** are currently listed as signatories of the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice as of July 2026.

**Breakdown:**
- **22 organisations** in the main signatory list (covering Transparency and Copyright, and in most cases Safety and Security chapters)
- **+1** (xAI) which signed only the Safety and Security Chapter

**Full list:**
Accexible, AI Studio Delta, Aleph Alpha, Almawave, Amazon, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Bria AI, Cohere, Domyn, Dweve, Fastweb, IBM, Lawise, LINAGORA, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Open Hippo, OpenAI, Pleias, ServiceNow, WRITER, and **xAII** (Safety and Security only).

**Key caveat:** The signatory list is actually hosted on the `/policies/contents-code-gpai` page, not the `/policies/ai-code-practice` URL mentioned in the question (which is the drafting/timeline page). The Commission explicitly notes the list is continuously updated as signatures are confirmed, so the count is dynamic and subject to change.

key_facts: 23 organisations are currently listed as signatories of the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (as of July 2026).
22 organisations appear in the main signatory list; xAI is a 23rd signatory that signed only the Safety and Security Chapter.
The signatory list is hosted on digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/contents-code-gpai, NOT on the /policies/ai-code-practice page referenced in the question.
xAI signed only Safety and Security and must demonstrate Transparency and Copyright compliance via alternative adequate means.

The main list (22) includes major AI firms: OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, Mistral AI, Cohere, Aleph Alpha, Black Forest Labs, ServiceNow, WRITER, Fastweb, Almawave, Domyn, LINAGORA, Pleias, Bria AI, and others.
The Code of Practice was published on 10 July 2025; relevant AI Act obligations applied from 2 August 2025.
The Commission states the signatory list is continuously updated as signatures are confirmed, so the count is subject to change.
